science-factory/mvp/gain.py and confront.about: science-factory/mvp/gain.py and confront.py (the candidate gain estimate)
science-factory/mvp/gain.py and confront.text: Without a quality screen the gain is steered by degraded passes at low stage. In known-answer tests built on the real 2024 pass times and gauge record, one-signed faults on a quarter of the lowest-stage passes cut interval coverage to 67 percent and raised false refutation right at the difference that matters to 34 percent and false confirmation there to 9 percent (2000 test cases per setting). In the 2024 record itself one pass with a degraded quality flag, at the year's lowest stage, carries about two thirds of the residual sum of squares. Proposed and written into the plan: exclude passes with reach_q at or above 2 before pairing and report the count.
science-factory/mvp/gain.py and confront.route: amend the recipe or the computation by pull request with the known-answer test evidence attached; a signed recipe stays stable and owes a signature

hydrology/knowledge/recipes/swot-gauge-c.about: hydrology/knowledge/recipes/swot-gauge-confrontation.md (mean error of the change and its interval)
hydrology/knowledge/recipes/swot-gauge-c.text: The mean error of the change is blind to gain. Its 95 percent interval contained zero in every one of 2000 known-answer test cases per setting at gains of 1.00 and 0.90 and under a 0.5 m per year drift, run through the unmodified executor. Algebraically the mean of the change errors is the last level difference minus the first, divided by the count, so it reads two passes; its reported spread is about six times its actual spread across test cases. An independent check found it responds only to a drift far larger than the noise. The change RMSD and correlation in the same recipe are unaffected. Proposed: amend the recipe to say what this score can and cannot detect, or replace it with the gain; the recipe is signed, so the amendment owes a re-signature.
hydrology/knowledge/recipes/swot-gauge-c.route: amend the recipe or the computation by pull request with the known-answer test evidence attached; a signed recipe stays stable and owes a signature

science-factory/mvp/gain.py (power under.about: science-factory/mvp/gain.py (power under an unflagged gross error)
science-factory/mvp/gain.py (power under.text: After the quality screen, one pass the product does not flag (2024-03-26, residual +0.86 m) carries about 70 percent of the residual sum of squares in the 2024 record. The interval still covers (the required gross-error cases: coverage 0.93), but the rule's power to support a true claim falls from about 0.95 in a kind case to about 0.49 when such passes occur. Proposed for the method work: a robust estimator written into the plan, or a plan that states the power it has when a gross error is present. Found by the second review pass.
